Our analysis

Of the 14 MPVs in our comparison, the Volkswagen ID. Buzz is the 1st most expensive to own.

Its biggest cost is depreciation: €37,563 over 5 years, 80% of the total.

A full charge of its 79 kWh battery costs about €13 at home, and 100 km about €3.47.

FAQ

How much does a Volkswagen ID. Buzz cost per month?

About €787 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.630 per km.

How much does it cost to charge the Volkswagen ID. Buzz?

A full charge of its 79 kWh battery costs about €13 at home at €0.15/kWh and €39 at a public charger at €0.49/kWh.

Which DGT label does the Volkswagen ID. Buzz have?

The ZERO label.
